name: Quote Finder
tagline: Verifies whether that famous quote is real, and says so when it is not
description: Name a person and a line you half-remember, and it goes looking for the verifiable source. Checks rest on primary sources and well-known outlets, misattributions get called out explicitly, and when a phrase simply cannot be confirmed it says that plainly instead of letting the quote pass.
author: MichaelDispigna
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
